text:
sam: Kickoff for VelaPay POC now. Objective: integrate LLM into merchant dispute workflow + smart routing to ops. Need prompt inventory, eval plan, timeline, and any pricing/security caveats. 4-week pilot. @lina you take lead?

lina: Yep. Quick list: dispute triage, suggested reply, entity extraction, and routing tag. Also need success criteria from customer: tolerance for false positives on fraud, SLA for latency, and redaction requirements.

omar: From eng side: we want a small, deterministic prompt set to minimize drift. Plan: 6 canonical prompts + a lightweight eval harness (100 labeled examples). Start with hosted model; consider Dedicated if they require EU-only hosting.

lina: Draft baseline prompts (working copy):

```
System: You are a strict support assistant. Never invent account numbers or confirm refunds without verification.

Prompt 1 (classify): "Read the customer message and return one tag: REFUND / FRAUD / CHARGEBACK / INFO. Include a confidence score 0-1 and note missing verification fields."

Prompt 2 (reply_short): "Generate a 2-3 sentence support reply that acknowledges the issue, lists next steps, and asks for any missing verification. Keep tone neutral and do not offer legal/financial advice. Max 140 chars."

Prompt 3 (entities_json): "Extract merchant, amount, currency, date, payment_last4, and possible reason. Return strict JSON only."
```

omar: Metrics proposal: classification accuracy >= 0.88, reply_quality >= 4/5 by human raters, hallucination events <= 3%, and median latency < 200ms. Use 90th perc < 350ms for demo.

lina: Security flags: they will send masked PANs (last4) and tokenized IDs. They require data residency in EU for production; POC can be hosted in us-east if they sign DPA addendum. Also requested SOC2 attestation and KMS info.

security-bot: Security checklist: SOC2: yes, DPA template: docs link, KMS/HSM: supported, audit logs retention: 90 days by default (extendable). Mark: escalate if they insist on on-prem for PII.

sam: On pricing: billing, what's a realistic hosted trial cost for 4 weeks?

billing: Rough hosted estimate: $1.6k - includes token usage + small infra. Dedicated quote will need a min commit; can get draft by Monday.

omar: Operational note: include a short warmup script for KV cache and precompute common reply prefixes to hit latency SLO during demo. Also use small batch size for low-latency endpoints.

lina: Eval plan: 1) Customer provides 100 anonymized threads (masking ok). 2) We label 30 gold for seed. 3) Run automated eval + 20 human ratings on reply quality. 4) Flag hallucinations manually.

lina: Example eval command:
```
./run_eval.sh --model hosted-v1 --prompts vela_prompts.json --gold gold_set.json --human-ratings 20 --out vela_results.json
# outputs: class_acc, reply_avg, halluc_pct, p95_latency
```

sam: Timeline suggestion: Week 0: finalize prompts + collect data. Week 1: run baseline + deliver metric sheet. Week 2: prompt tuning + iterate. Week 3: stability + A/B test small quantized variant. Week 4: final demo + handoff. Sounds okay?

omar: Good. I'll prep baseline prompt files by EOD tomorrow. Lina, I'll need the acceptance matrix to show to the customer.

lina: I'll produce an acceptance matrix mapping each prompt to pass/fail test and thresholds. Also a short README explaining how we measure hallucination (we count fabricated accounts, wrong amounts, and invented merchants; severity levels: minor/major/critical).

billing: Please include a short note in the contract draft about data handling during POC (masked-only, logs retained 30 days, delete on request).

security-bot: Also include a line about KMS key rotation and who has access to keys for Dedicated.

sam: Assignments: omar -> prompt files + eval harness, lina -> acceptance matrix + customer doc, security-bot -> draft sec answers for questionnaire, billing -> provisional pricing + contract note. Deliverables due by Friday EOD.

lina: Setting 20-min sync for Thursday to review progress. Calendar invite shortly. :calendar: 

omar: One more Q: do we measure reply helpfulness via binary accept/reject or Likert? Prefer Likert 1-5.

lina: Likert 1-5 and a binary pass for safety checks. Good to have both.

sam: If any enterprise blockers pop, escalate to me. Also mention Dedicated/Private timeline if requested (typically 2-4 weeks infra provisioning).

lina: Thanks team. I'll post the draft prompts + acceptance matrix to the Confluence page and ping the customer for sample data.

omar: Great, thanks.
